name: airline-booking-with-flight-search
description: Invoke the airline-booking-with-flight-search SOP to govern validation, flight search, and booking for this request.

name: Validate required input and airport codes
description: Check that the required inputs are present. Validate that origin and destination are 3-letter IATA airport codes. If either is missing, is a city name, or is not a valid 3-letter code, do not convert or guess; set message asking the passenger for the airport code, set status no_flights, and stop.

name: Select phase based on flight_number
description: If no flight_number is supplied, continue with the search phase. If a flight_number is supplied, continue with the book phase.

name: flight-search-agent
description: SEARCH PHASE only: delegate the flight search to flight-search-agent with the typed input {'origin': '<ORIGIN>', 'destination': '<DESTINATION>', 'travel_date': '<DEPARTURE_DATE>'}. Do not call a flight-search tool directly, and do not book anything.

name: Process flight search response
description: Read the response from flight-search-agent. If flights are reported, prepare each returned flight's number, departure/arrival times, fare, and seats available for output. If it reports no flights, set message suggesting other dates or airport codes and set status no_flights.

name: Assemble search options output
description: When flights are available, set status options_presented and populate the flights field with every flight reported by flight-search-agent. Never invent flights, fares, or availability.

name: Validate booking inputs and adult presence
description: BOOK PHASE only: ensure flight_number, departure_date, and passenger list are present; if any is missing, report exactly what is missing and stop. Also check that the passenger list contains at least one adult; if not, refuse the booking, explain in the message field that a child or infant cannot travel without an adult, set status no_flights, and stop.

name: create-booking
description: BOOK PHASE with a valid adult: invoke the create-booking skill to book the supplied flight_number for the passengers on departure_date and generate the payment link. Do not search again.

name: Assemble booking output
description: After create-booking returns a PNR and payment link, populate the output with message and status booked, or paid if payment settlement has already been confirmed. Include pnr, flight_number, origin, destination, departure, passenger_count, amount_due, and payment_link. Never invent PNRs, fares, or payment links.

name: Report tool or agent errors verbatim
description: If any tool, skill, or delegated agent error occurs, report the error verbatim in the message field and stop without fabricating flights, fares, PNRs, or payment links.
